raw_segments.text: But it was all for the sake of Little Toomai, who had seen what never man had seen before
the dance of the elephants at night and alone in the heart of the Garo hills!
But it was all for the sake of Little Toomai, who had seen what never man had seen before
the dance of the elephants at night, and alone in the heart of the Garo Hills.
But it was all for the sake of little Tumai, who had seen what never man had seen before
the dance of the elephants at night and alone in the heart of the Garo Hills.
